reason: A local knowledge-management and review plugin that stores user materials, retrieves evidence for answers, supports categorization and reading, and optionally imports OCR or ASR content through configured services.

summaries.zh: 一个面向中文 DSH 用户的本地知识管理与复习插件，用于保存资料、检索证据、生成摘要并基于知识库辅助问答。
summaries.en: A local knowledge-management and review plugin for DSH that stores materials, retrieves evidence, generates summaries, and supports knowledge-base-assisted answers.

capabilities: Stores user-provided text, OCR output, and ASR transcripts in a local knowledge base
Searches locally stored evidence before generating knowledge answers
Reads and writes local JSONL indexes, document files, categories, journals, and migration backups
Can optionally send public image or audio URLs to configured OCR or ASR services when explicitly enabled
Can use the current DSH model to generate or update Markdown summaries
